entries.title: Jeremiah 35:1
segments: The word which came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim the sons of Josiah king of Judah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:2
segments: Go to the house of the Rechabites and speak to them, and bring them into the house of the LORD, into one of the rooms. And give them wine to drink.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:3
segments: Then I took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habaziniah, and his brothers, and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:4
segments: And I brought them into the house of the LORD, into the room of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which [was] near the room of the rulers, above the room of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:5
segments: And I set pots full of wine, and cups, before the sons of the house of the Rechabites. And I said to them, Drink wine!

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:6
segments: But they said, We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab our father commanded us, saying, You shall drink no wine, [you] nor your sons forever.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:7
segments: Nor shall you build houses, nor sow seed, nor plant a vineyard, nor have [anything]; but all your days you shall live in tents, so that you may live many days in the land where you are strangers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:8
segments: So we have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab our father in all that he has commanded us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, nor our daughters;

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:9
segments: nor to build houses for us to live in. Nor do we have vineyard, nor field, nor seed.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:10
segments: But we have lived in tents, and have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:11
segments: But it happened when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, we said, Come and let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the Chaldean army, and for fear of the Syrian army. So we are living at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:12
segments: Then came the word of the LORD to Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:13
segments: So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Go and tell the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, Will you not receive instruction to listen to My words? says the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:14
segments: The words of Jonadab the son of Rechab, which he commanded his sons not to drink wine, are done. For to this day they do not drink, but obey their father's commandment. But I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, but you did not listen to Me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:15
segments: I have also sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending, saying, Return now each man from his evil way, and make your doings good, and do not go after other gods to serve them, and you shall dwell in the land which I have given to you and to your fathers. But you have not bowed down your ear, nor listened to Me.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:16
segments: Because the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have done the commandment of their father, which He commanded them; but this people has not listened to Me;

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:17
segments: therefore so says the LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel: Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem all the evil that I have spoken against them. Because I have spoken to them, but they have not heard; and I have called to them, but they have not answered.

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:18
segments: And Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites, So says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Because you have obeyed the command of Jonadab your father, and have kept all his precepts, and have done according to all that he has commanded you;

entries.title: Jeremiah 35:19
segments: therefore so says the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not lack a man to stand before Me forever.
